# Architecture Recommendation

Based on the stated constraints, I recommend a **modular monolith or layered architecture** with clear separation of concerns. This approach balances accessibility (through a well-designed interface layer), maintainability (via organized, decoupled modules), and cost-efficiency (avoiding the operational complexity and infrastructure costs of microservices). As the system grows, this foundation can evolve toward microservices if needed, without requiring a complete rewrite.
